'''Celomar''' was the personal [[Aide/Legends|aide]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Caerbellak]]. Celomar was present during a royal [[Parade/Legends|parade]] on [[Rydonni Prime]], where the aide informed Caerbellak that an Imperial [[Rythani Products prototype|prototype]] weapon being developed by [[Rythani Products]] had been stolen. Celomar later ordered a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to go after the [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]], [[Sienn Sconn]], but Caerbellak ordered the aide to tell the [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] not to engage. Celomar disagreed with this line of reasoning but followed orders anyway.<ref name="Easy" />
